verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is API-driven and server-to-server, so it can be automated without a UI. Evidence shows a batch Feed API (up to 200 items per request), Cart API session endpoints called from your server, webhooks that remove the need for polling, and published OpenAPI definitions on GitHub. Nothing addresses CI pipelines specifically, though, and there is no CLI or headless-runner tooling. missing for 10: CI/CD integration docs, an official CLI or headless automation tooling, test/sandbox automation guidance for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.
